lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance, circular spots arranged in vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of pale-to-moderate pixel intensity that intersect with the longitudinal carinae and white spots, forming a nodal lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent, horizontally-oriented ridges running parallel along the upper-to-mid flank, exhibiting a sharp light-on-top, shadow-on-bottom vertical luminance gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible attached to the dorsal surface of the neck and anterior trunk region.
